cases.description: Microsoft's documented example: standard normal cumulative distribution at z = 1.333333
cases.expected_note: Microsoft publishes this example's result as 0.908788726. Independently verified against the standard normal CDF: Phi(1.333333) = 0.908788726 -> 0.908789 at 6 dp

cases.description: Same z with cumulative FALSE returns the standard normal density
cases.expected_note: Microsoft publishes this example's result as 0.164010148. Independently verified from the standard normal density exp(-z^2/2)/sqrt(2*pi) = 0.164010148 -> 0.164010 at 6 dp

cases.description: The standard normal CDF at zero is one half
cases.expected_note: The standard normal is symmetric about 0, so Phi(0) = 0.5 exactly

cases.description: Symmetry check: Phi(-z) + Phi(z) must be exactly 1
cases.expected_note: Phi(-z) = 1 - Phi(z) for the standard normal, so the two cumulative values sum to 1 for any z

cases.description: A non-numeric z is a value error
cases.expected_note: 'If z is nonnumeric, NORM.S.DIST returns the #VALUE! error' -- the only error condition documented for this function
